name: Termination for Default (Non-Performance)
text: If the Service Provider fails to perform the Services within the agreed timelines or to the agreed standard, such failure shall constitute a default. The Client may, upon written notice, terminate this Agreement in whole or in part, and may procure substitute services from a third party, holding the Service Provider liable for any excess cost so incurred. The Client may also recover, by way of liquidated damages or compensation, any loss suffered as a result of the default, in accordance with the Indian Contract Act, 1872. Termination for default shall be without prejudice to any other right or remedy of the Client.

legal_basis.note: Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach
Compensation for breach where penalty / liquidated damages stipulated

invalid_if: Liquidated damages are extravagant and unconscionable (penalty)
title: Termination for Default
